tool_args.rationale: The target horizon of 24.3 is far beyond the pilot horizon of 0.48. A slow-horizon probe can identify the proposed adaptation and distinguish a reversal from competing mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential adaptation model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short, correlated horizon and input range leaves the slow component and long-horizon reversal poorly identified.
Additional short-horizon detail would not directly resolve the long-horizon ambiguity.
The pilot alone does not discriminate these alternatives reliably at the target horizon.
